verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a dedicated `cookies` parameter to "pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape" (docs-43). JavaScript rendering is on by default (docs-16), and `session_id` can route repeated requests through the same IP (docs-12), which supports fetching authenticated pages. The evidence is only a one-line parameter description, though. Missing for 10: documentation of the cookie string format and domain/path scoping, any explicit statement that cookies apply in the headless-browser rendering path, and independent or hands-on confirmation that authenticated pages load successfully.
